about: BDS Towing & Recovery is a family-owned and operated towing and recovery company that has served the Bryan area since 2000.
It handles light and heavy-duty towing, recovery and semi wrecker work.
In July 2026, KBTX reported that BDS donated a van to VFW Post 4692 in Bryan to support local veterans.
